name: CONDO_AREA
description:
This dataset contains records describing individual condominium units and their associated building and spatial attributes, drawn from a municipal property data source (created by DOF_OWNDP in October 2024). Each of the 1,263 rows represents a condo unit or related structure, with 22 columns covering identifiers, geometry, and descriptive details.

Key fields include objectid (a unique row identifier), elevation, shape_area and shape_length (footprint geometry measures), and building-level identifiers such as base_bbl, bin, and condo_key. Unit-level fields include unit_lot, unit_bbl, unit_designation, floor_text, and floor_num, which describe the unit's lot number, designation, and floor location. Room-level attributes include room_height and room_desc (e.g., "STUDIO," "1BED 1BATH," or roof terrace notes), while base_height and top_height capture vertical extents where available. A model field (mostly "D")
